_comment: The concourse from examples/level-2-missed-connection, declared as it was actually built. This is the manifest that never existed, reconstructed from the approved reference frames. It reproduces the two continuity defects that shipped: a pillar present in SH02 and in no scene declaration, and a departure board mounted on the column in SH01 but hanging free in SH02.
